title: Задания 1–4: Понимание основного содержания (диалоги в разных местах)
audioScript: Dialogue A: Good morning! Can I see your passport and boarding pass, please? Sure, here you are. Do you have any luggage to check in, or just this carry-on backpack? Just the backpack. Perfect, your gate is B14. Dialogue B: Two tickets for the 3D showing of Galaxy Explorers, please. Row 7 in the middle is available. Would you like some large popcorn and drinks with that? Dialogue C: Excuse me, where can I find science fiction novels and dictionaries? Go straight to the second floor, next to the study desks. Dialogue D: Doctor, my dog hasn't eaten anything since yesterday and seems very tired. Let me examine his paws and temperature first.

title: Задание 5: Сопоставление говорящих со школьными темами (A–E)
audioScript: Speaker A: I love biology because we do hands-on experiments with microscopes every Thursday. Speaker B: For me, foreign languages open doors to travelling and meeting friends from all continents. Speaker C: Solving complex algebraic equations is like cracking a code; math is pure logic! Speaker D: Physical education keeps my mind fresh after six hours of sitting at a desk. Speaker E: History lets us travel back in time to understand why our world is shaped this way.

title: Задания 6–11: Заполнение таблицы по интервью (Fact-filling)
audioScript: Interviewer: Welcome to our youth podcast, Mark! Tell our listeners about yourself. Mark: Hi! My name is Mark Turner. I am fourteen years old. I live in Manchester. Interviewer: What is your primary hobby? Mark: I have been into 3D animation for two years. I attend a robotics club every Wednesday at five o'clock. Interviewer: What pet do you have? Mark: I have a ginger cat named Oscar. Interviewer: And what is your dream profession? Mark: I want to become a software engineer at a game studio.
